RDT Connect • macOS Installation Guide

1 / 2

1Open RDT Connect

Option ASpotlight Search

Press ⌘ + Space, type “rdt,” then press Return.

OR

Option BApplications Folder

Open Applications, then double-click RDT Connect.

2Click Done, then open System Settings.

3Select Privacy & Security, then click Open Anyway.

4Click Open Anyway again.

The guide is displayed from local files; this page does not contact a server.
